name: Slavic Languages and Literatures: Russian and East European Studies

declaration.notes: Meet with the Director of Undergraduate Programs, then submit the College Declare a Major or Minor form.

requirements.label: Language
requirements.note: Third-year Russian, or first-year Polish in addition to Russian through RUSS 2020.

requirements.label: Russian politics
requirements.note: 3 hours on Russian politics; which courses qualify is set by the department.

requirements.label: Russian / East European folklore
requirements.note: 3 hours of Russian or East European folklore; approximated by subject.

requirements.label: Electives
requirements.note: 9 hours of related electives, apparently at most 3 in Slavic; plan with the DUP.

notes: Concentration of the Slavic major, built from the department's summary of the 30-hour Russian and East European Studies track. Not verified against the Undergraduate Record.
